**Teehee**  
**A solo fallen coin grind with modifiers**

# **Credits**

Creator: @myuuuu\_  
Contributor: @yunwanjia2027

# **Notes**

* Must be in [**Paradoxum Group**](https://www.roblox.com/groups/4914494/Paradoxum-Games#!/about) for an extra **100\$**.  
* This strategy doesn’t require skill tree on  
* It’s needed to have Operator at max XP level  
* It’s needed to have Juggernaut at level 16 XP  
* Consumables are not needed.  
* Always use **Green Track** ability as soon as you can. It’s recommended to use **Red Track** ability to defense melt  enemies.  
* It’s not recommended to use **timescale** if you are not familiar with the strat.  
* If you are using **timescale** (without/low skill tree) change to 1.5x as soon as **Fallen King** appears if you are using **Commander.**  
* Always use **AirDrop  at the back of the map.**  
* Always use/chain **CTA.**  
  * Use **Support Caravan** before **Wave 40** starts and use it whenever you can in **Wave 40\.** You can always use **Support Caravan** for a faster time.

# **Strategy**

| Difficulty: Medium [POV](https://youtu.be/P0rOtcYTons) |  |  |  |  |

| **Operator** | **Shotgunner**/**Executioner** | **Commander/Merc Base** | **DJ Booth** | **Juggernaut** |
| **Important** | **Strategy** |  |  |  |
| **Placement Map** | ![][image12] |  |  |  |
| **Wave Skipping Tips** | Change DJ Booth to **Red Track** in **Wave 25\.** Auto skip until **Wave 26\.** Skip these waves **only if** there’s **1** enemy left: **Wave 27, 30 \- 32, 34, 36** **Do not** skip these waves: **35, 37, 38\.** Skip **Wave 39** **only if** **Fallen Guardian** has 15k HP or less. |  |  |  |
| **Waves: 1 \- 20** | Place 3 Lv 2 **Operators** \> 11 Lv 2 **Operators** Place Lv 3 **DJ Booth** \[**Green Track**\] \> Upgrade all **Operators** to Lv 4 \> Max **DJ Booth** |  |  |  |
| **Waves: 21 \- 40** | Place 1 Lv 2 **Commander** or 1 Lv 3 **Merc Base \[3 Rifleman\]** Upgrade all **Operators** to Lv 5 \> Place 2 Lv 5 back **Operators** Max **Shotgunners/Executioners** \> Max **Operators** \> Max 3 **Commanders** or Max 1 **Merc Base** Max **Juggernaut** \[Top Path\] \> Max 2 **Merc Bases \[5 Rifleman, 1 Field Medic\]** |  |  |  |

# **Common Issues**

| Waves | Reasons |  |  |  |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **1 \- 20** | Bad **Operator** placements Slow **Operator** upgrades. |  |  |  |
| **21-40** | Didn’t change **DJ Booth** to **Red Track** Didn’t place back **Operators.** Didn’t chain **CTA** Didn’t follow **Wave Skipping Tips** (or Overskipped) Didn’t use **AirDrop** at the back of the map. |  |  |  |
